step: SE5 cycle 1/3 -- origin gate accepts localhost:4242 + 127.0.0.1:4242
trigger: Operator FAIL at STEP 5 gate -- PyWebView preview iframe shows 'Preview unavailable in standalone testing'; isProductionContext() returning false; suspected Apply to OBS also silently failing.

diagnosis.root_cause: Browsers (including WebView2) treat 'localhost' and '127.0.0.1' as DISTINCT origins for same-origin policy purposes. customize.exe navigates to localhost host but Stage 7.27 SE5 fix only whitelisted 127.0.0.1. isProductionContext() returned false in PyWebView -> all server-side fetches short-circuited -> preview iframe srcdoc placeholder shown -> Apply to OBS silently no-op.
diagnosis.stage_7_29_smoke_blind_spot: Stage 7.29 STEP 6 smoke ran via preview MCP at localhost:8765 -- also NOT production origin, so isProductionContext returned false there too. The bug was invisible to standalone smoke because BOTH the test environment AND PyWebView were non-production origins; the difference (different port) masked the hostname mismatch.

fix.shape: Replace EXPECTED_SERVER_ORIGIN string with EXPECTED_SERVER_ORIGINS array accepting both localhost:4242 and 127.0.0.1:4242
